verdict.rationale: Hatchet documents a self-hosting option where you run your own instance of the Hatchet Control Plane. That lets a user decide where orchestration data lives by choosing where to deploy it. Nothing in the evidence shows region or data-residency selection for the managed cloud, and the docs never frame self-hosting as a residency control. Missing for 10: managed-cloud region selection, explicit data-residency documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Self-hosting Hatchet means running your own instance of the Hatchet Control Plane - the central orchestration system that manages workflows, schedules tasks, and coordinates worker execution.
